newsitem.title: USA: Golden Eagle acquires Bechtrans' US unit.
newsitem.headline: Golden Eagle acquires Bechtrans' US unit.

text.p: Golden Eagle Group Inc said Wednesday that it has reached agreement with Bechtrans International of Australia to merge the latter's U.S. freight operations into those of freight forwarder DAHER Golden Eagle.
The two companies also exchanged exclusive agency representation agreements covering U.S.-Australia traffic.

"The addition of Bechtrans U.S. should greatly strengthen the West Coast operation of DAHER Golden Eagle and will create a strong trading partnership between the U.S. and Australia," Patrick Weston, president Golden Eagle Group, said in a statement.
